judge_notes.opus5: Item 0 is the unaggregated fact: a restructuring banker (ex-PWP/Blackstone, founder of a debt-restructuring boutique) put on a Strategy Committee at $30k a month in the same 8-K whose item 8.01 the wires covered, with the 12 Oct lender condition failed and Bloomberg's 'as soon as November' timing landing on a November release; the equity at 2.5% of net debt keeps the upside path (item 2) alive, which is why p_up is 42 and not 25.
judge_notes.opus55: A monthly-fee restructuring banker added to the strategy committee, and a failed lender condition with a 22 Dec maturity, make the 9 Nov release the likely venue for an RSA or filing; the extension path is real but less likely; the stock has option-like equity value at $0.14.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Failed lender condition, restructuring-banker director and 22 Dec maturity point to RSA/filing, offset by extension option value on a $0.14 stub; heavy tail.
judge_notes.fable51: Items 0 and 1: a $30k-a-month restructuring banker put on the strategy committee in the same 8-K that disclosed the failed lender condition, with the first scheduled update landing in the month Bloomberg named for a filing, on a $0.14 equity that still carries option value against a 22 Dec maturity.
